 AI Engineer

**Responsibilities**
* Design and implement AI\-powered solutions integrated with HaloITSM and third\-party platforms.
* Develop use cases leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and workflow automation.
* Design AI architectures utilizing Halo Open APIs, enterprise applications, knowledge repositories, and operational data sources.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical business applications.
* Build proof\-of\-concepts and pilot programs for customers.
* Conduct AI discovery workshops with customers.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, automation, knowledge management, and user experience through AI.
* Translate business requirements into AI solution designs.
* Present technical and business concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Act as a trusted advisor for AI strategy and adoption.
* Develop integrations between AI platforms and enterprise systems.
* Build AI\-powered assistants, knowledge search solutions, virtual agents, and automation workflows.
* Implement AI governance, security, and data privacy best practices.
* Create reusable frameworks, accelerators, and templates.
* Support production AI solutions and troubleshoot complex issues.
* Define PartnerVP's AI service offerings and go\-to\-market strategy.
* Mentor developers, consultants, and junior technical resources.
* Establish AI architecture standards and delivery methodologies.
* Assist with sales opportunities, solution demonstrations, and proposal development.
* Help build a scalable AI consulting and implementation practice.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of software development, solution architecture, or enterprise technology consulting experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing or implementing AI solutions.
* Strong programming experience in one or more of the following: Python, C\#, JavaScript/Node.js, or Java.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and enterprise integrations.
* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or similar AI platforms.
* Strong understanding of prompt engineering and AI application design.
* Experience designing customer\-facing solutions and leading technical discussions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Experience with vector databases and semantic search technologies.

* Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM), or ITIL practices.
